subject: Replacement parts for a damaged item
draftBody:
A single damaged part does not need the whole appliance returned. Ask for the order number and a photo of the damage, then send the part on its own — bowls, lids, seals and blades are all stocked separately.

The part ships on the next working day and the customer keeps the appliance. A full return is only needed when the fault is in the motor or the housing.
